description: Build, run and analyze aerosol simulations; report concerns; develop, test and document Particula with illustrated examples.

defaultPrompt: Help me install Particula and check my local Python environment.
Build and run a small condensation simulation, then plot and explain the results.
Debug my Particula script and check its units, conservation, and time-step sensitivity.
interface.longDescription: Ten researcher workflows for setup, guidance, simulation design, chamber analysis, reaction discovery, execution, analysis, TOC figure design, debugging and issue reporting, plus six Particula repository skills for planning, development, testing, documentation, illustrated example authoring and review. Uses the selected checkout and environment. Reports require researcher review before posting. No hosted service, automatic Python installation or MCP server is included.

publication.release_notes: The TOC figure skill now uses a shared Matplotlib style and the Particula dots logo. It explains how to commit an editable generator with each literature figure and how to place the figure beside a wrapping study abstract.

name: particula-helper
